t2.title: Social media good for teenagers
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: “Is social media good for teenagers?” Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
```html Is Social Media Good for Teenagers?

Is Social Media Good for Teenagers?

In today's digital age, it can be quite challenging for teenagers to imagine life without social media. Platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat have become an integral part of their daily routines. But is this pervasive presence truly beneficial?

There are certainly some undeniable benefits to social media. Undoubtedly, it allows teenagers to stay connected with friends and family, and fosters a sense of community by enabling them to engage with like-minded individuals worldwide. For instance, teens interested in specific hobbies or causes can easily find and join groups where they can share ideas and learn from each other.

However, there are significant downsides as well. The constant exposure to curated online personas can lead to unrealistic comparisons, breeding feelings of inadequacy or anxiety. Moreover, the addictive nature of social media takes away from face-to-face interactions, which are crucial for developing social skills.

Ultimately, whether social media is good for teenagers depends on how it’s used. If managed wisely, it could be a force for good. However, it’s essential for both teenagers and parents to set boundaries and monitor usage to ensure it doesn’t negatively impact mental health or real-world relationships.

```
t2.sampleA1:
Hi Teacher,

Trip! Good. I like park. Play games. One day. Bye.
t2.sampleA2:
Hi Teacher,

I want to go to the beach. I like swimming and playing in the sand. It is fun. I think one day is good, because two days is long. We can eat ice cream and drink juice. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Teacher,

I think the class trip should be to the city museum. It's interesting and we can learn a lot about history. I think we should have a tour guide. Also, we could visit the park after the museum. I think one day is enough because we have a lot of school work. We can eat lunch at the museum cafe. I hope you like my idea.

Your Student
t2.sampleB2: Scroll, tap, like, repeat — for most teenagers today, social media is simply part of everyday life. But is it doing us more good than harm? On the bright side, platforms like Instagram and TikTok help young people stay in touch with friends and express themselves creatively. They also open doors to learning: countless teenagers pick up new skills, from cooking to coding, just by watching short videos. For those who feel shy in person, online communities can be a real lifeline, offering a place to belong. That said, there is a darker side. Endlessly comparing ourselves to picture-perfect influencers can chip away at our confidence and leave us feeling anxious. On top of that, spending hours glued to a screen often eats into sleep, study time and real conversations. So, where does that leave us? In my view, social media is neither a villain nor a hero — it all comes down to how we use it. If teenagers set sensible limits and think before they post, it can be a powerful tool rather than a trap. The key, as always, is balance.

Bugungi raqamli davrda o‘smirlar uchun ijtimoiy tarmoqlarsiz hayotni tasavvur qilish juda qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin. Instagram, TikTok va Snapchat kabi platformalar ularning kundalik hayotining ajralmas qismiga aylandi. Ammo bu keng tarqalgan ishtirok haqiqatan ham foydalimi?

Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning ba'zi inkor etib bo'lmas afzalliklari, albatta, mavjud. Shubhasiz, u o'smirlarga do'stlari va oilasi bilan aloqada bo'lishga imkon beradi va ularga butun dunyo bo'ylab fikrdosh odamlar bilan muloqot qilish imkoniyatini berish orqali hamjamiyat tuyg'usini shakllantiradi. Misol uchun, muayyan hobbi yoki maqsadlarga qiziquvchi o'smirlar o'zaro fikr almashish va bir-biridan o'rganishlari mumkin bo'lgan guruhlarni osongina topishlari va ularga qo'shilishlari mumkin.

Biroq, sezilarli kamchiliklar ham mavjud. Onlayn shaxslarning doimiy ta'siri nomuvofiq taqqoslashlarga olib kelishi, yetishmovchilik yoki tashvish hissini uyg'otishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning o'rganib qolish xususiyati ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirish uchun juda muhim bo'lgan yuzma-yuz muloqotdan vaqtni oladi.

Oxir oqibat, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning o'smirlar uchun foydali yoki yo'qligi ulardan qanday foydalanishga bog'liq. Agar oqilona boshqarilsa, u yaxshilik uchun kuch bo'lishi mumkin. Biroq, o'smirlar va ota-onalar uchun ruhiy salomatlikka yoki real hayotdagi munosabatlarga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmasligini ta'minlash uchun chegaralar belgilash va foydalanishni nazorat qilish muhimdir.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is also your classmate. Write about your feelings and what you think the school should do. Write your response in about 50 words.
t11.sample: ```html Hey Muattar, I’m absolutely thrilled about the trip idea! I reckon we should hit the beach for a perfect getaway. Imagine playing beach volleyball, going for a swim, and just chilling by the water. A two-day trip sounds like a dream come true, right? It'd be a fantastic opportunity to bond and make memories. Let's make sure to suggest some fun activities. Can't wait to hear what you think! Cheers, Akmal Nazarov ```

t12.title: formal letter · to teacher
t12.prompt: Write a letter to your teacher. Write about your feelings and what you think the school should do. Write your response in 120-150 words.
t12.sample: ```html Dear Teacher, I hope you're doing well! I'm genuinely excited about the end-of-term class trip and would love to share a few thoughts. First and foremost, I think we should consider heading to a popular outdoor adventure park. These parks often offer a variety of activities such as team-building exercises, which could be both fun and educational. Regarding the trip's duration, a two-day trip might be ideal. This gives us enough time to fully immerse ourselves in the experience without feeling rushed. Additionally, spending a night away could help foster stronger bonds among classmates. Activities like hiking or a friendly sports competition would provide just the right amount of excitement and relaxation. Meanwhile, it is crucial that students bring some cash for emergencies. Although the school is providing food and drinks, having cash can offer peace of mind. Thank you for considering our input. I'm truly looking forward to this memorable experience. Warm regards, Akmal Nazarov ```
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Teacher,

I want trip. Park is good. One day. I like park. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Teacher,

I want to go to the zoo. It is fun. We can see animals. I like animals and my friends like animals too. I think one day is good, because two days is long. I need money for ice cream, but the school gives food. Thank you.

From, Akmal Nazarov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Teacher,

I am writing to you about the class trip. I think it would be a good idea to go to the beach. We could swim and play volleyball. Also, we could have a bonfire at night. I think that would be really fun.

In my opinion, we should go for two days because one day is not enough time to do everything. However, a two-day trip might be more expensive. It is important that we bring money for emergencies, like you said. I am excited about the trip.

Sincerely,
Akmal Nazarov
t12.sampleB2: Dear Teacher, Thank you for your email about the end-of-term class trip. I'm genuinely excited about it and would like to put forward a few suggestions. To begin with, I think a visit to the science museum would be ideal, as it is both educational and enjoyable. We could explore the interactive exhibits and take part in a guided workshop, which would bring our lessons to life. As for the length, I would strongly recommend a two-day trip. A single day would feel rushed, whereas two days would give us the chance to get to know each other better outside the classroom. Finally, I appreciate that the school is providing food and drinks, and I will make sure to bring some cash for emergencies, as you advised. Thank you for considering our ideas. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Piyoda sayr qilish yoki do'stona sport musobaqalari kabi tadbirlar ayni muddao bo'ladigan hayajon va dam olishni ta'minlaydi. tasks.p1_context: You are a student at school and you received this email from your teacher.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Students,

We’re planning a class trip at the end of the term. Food and drinks will be provided by the school. But you need to bring some money in cash for emergencies. Where would you like us to go? What activities should we do there? Should it be a one-day or two-day trip? Please send me your ideas by email.

Your Teacher.
